title: The cast into the diamond puts the ones below
assumes: The ones pass through, turn, cast round one and step into the middle — and the cast round one is a cast down the set, so by the time the diamond forms the ones are standing in the twos' place and everything after it is danced from there.
quotes: A1  (8) Ones pass through across (1R); turn right; cast clockwise around one; step into center and face partner in distance; form diamonds
notes: Written on both passes, because Jeremy Corners is a two-pass record with the twos active in the second. The clause is on the turn-alone that forms the diamond, so the whole eight-beat cast is danced in the seating it leaves and the square through, the corners and both swings are danced in the new one. **Measured** at six couples: `closure 32.0000 · progressed 37.7359 · reach 1.7570 short · collision 0.000`, against the record's `0.0000 · 37.7359 · 0.0000 · 0.000`. `progressed` does not move: this dance's 37.7359 px is across the set and a place along, and nothing in this reading crosses the set.
